releases.change: Benefits that come years later move with the discount rate: GiveWell's typed-in development effects, deworming and malaria income present values and development shares rescale to your rate (later_benefits in link-givewell-shared.py); TLYCS dispensers' income share rescales like the other readers; HLI's GiveDirectly splits recipient and household (a side effect) and is discounted over the years the effect lasts.
AMF's 2023 DRC sheet: the pasted total after leverage/funging becomes the computed total times the sheet's ratio, so side effects, the value of a child's life and the discount rate reach its result.

ACE's 2026 SADs carry no species weight (AIM v2): Greener by Default takes the shared species step with @aim_sads.<s>_2026 = 1, so the Rethink Priorities toggle is read and its evaluator view counts ACE's SADs as SADs.
Spending is recorded, never guessed: #spending needs a figure from accounts or the evaluator's model; wavg has no fill; Clear Solutions and ACTRA, with neither, leave the weighted average.
A charity with no spending on record weighs the median of the others in the same weighted average (wavg), not its cause's median.
Ambitious Impact's average of its charities weighs each by programme spending (#spending:<charity>); #cause:x stays equal-weight, and 2.8 says why.
Rules text: Animal Policy International's import rules carry the EU cage-free egg-import cost.
Cause aggregates (#cause:x) leave out what the rankings leave out, purely theoretical models included.
Purely theoretical models are shown but never ranked.

Versioning starts: the rules and audit skill as of this date. Every model whose audit passed on its current content is stamped 0.1.0; each earlier rule change (credit-switch-co-funders, mobiliser-share-imports, mobiliser-share-30) was applied to every model.
